noted.what: After a Thai sale of one child and one adult, the customer half's thank-you screen shows "Credit Grants — Credit ฿350" with a QR, while the platform granted no credit for that sale and the staff half shows no "Credit Grants to Print" block.
noted.compare: 08-walk-in-tourist-sale-paid-cash.png (Tourist: the adult pays ฿350, one grant, both halves agree)
noted.read: GET /sales/:id of the Thai sale: lines kids 1 x 42000 and adults_free 1 x 0, grants []. The package on staging: adultRules.thai set_price 35000, freebies [{kind: adult, tiers: [thai], quantity: 1}], creditRule {appliesTo: adults, basis: full_price}.
noted.cause: The till builds the sale's own grant list from the adult rule alone (apps/pos/src/lib/sale.ts:66-102, resolveAdultLine at :73) and does not take off the adult a free-items rule lets in (packages/shared/src/pricing.ts:116), so it counts that adult as paying ฿350 and earning ฿350. The customer screen reads that list (apps/pos/src/components/till/CustomerDisplay.tsx:869-906) and the till mints its own wallet for it (apps/pos/src/pages/Till.tsx:3111-3115). The platform reads the ledger, where the adult is adults_free at 0, and grants nothing (packages/shared/src/wallet.ts:186-203). The staff half follows the platform (apps/pos/src/components/till/StepConfirmation.tsx:296-299).
